Welcome to NEON QUANTUM DERBY—an ML competition visualized like a futuristic race! Watch seven model “drivers” sprint through latency zones, accuracy checkpoints, and sudden adversarial drift. The winners aren’t just fast—they stay correct when the track changes.

In this video you’ll see:
• Live-style race UI concepts (speed, accuracy, drift stress)
• How adversarial data shifts challenge predictors
• Why latency + robustness beats raw accuracy alone
